about: What each game brings into the mashup, and how it is read. Nothing from either game is copied into the other game's folder or into the upload: ROUNDS runs from the player's own ROUNDS folder, VS from theirs.

columns.read: how it reaches the mashup at runtime
columns.link: link rows carrying it, or none

rows.what: ROUNDS's two players, Orange and Blue: their particle bodies, faces, legs, arms, gun and health bar
rows.read: the hidden ROUNDS makes them with its own PlayerAssigner and renders them every frame

rows.what: ROUNDS's gun, bullets, ammo, reload, block and every card effect, mod cards included
rows.read: ROUNDS's own code runs them in the hidden ROUNDS against mirrored VS enemies

rows.what: ROUNDS's cards and its card pick screen (5 cards, rarities, art, descriptions)
rows.read: ROUNDS's CardChoice in the hidden ROUNDS, rendered into the shared picture

rows.what: ROUNDS's gun, hit, block and pick sounds
rows.read: played by the hidden ROUNDS itself at VS's sound-effects volume

rows.what: Orange's and Blue's pictures in VS's character select
rows.read: rendered by the hidden ROUNDS into %LOCALAPPDATA%/VampireRounds/portraits

rows.what: VS's Mad Forest: its map, enemy waves, bosses, Reaper, music, pickups, chests and light sources
rows.read: VS plays its own stage from the player's install; the adventure only lists it

rows.what: VS's enemies and bosses, their health, damage, knockback, freezing and death (gems, gold, kills)
rows.read: read from VS's live enemy list every frame; ROUNDS's hits go through VS's own damage path

rows.what: VS's experience, level-ups, gold, chests, revivals and game over
rows.read: VS's own systems; level-ups and chests become ROUNDS picks
